name: week
title: The monitoring week
subtitle: Fictional demo. Reconcile each source window before relying on its metrics.

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: SELECT name,version,owner,review_due,status,distance,mae,unreviewed_windows FROM monitoring_queue ORDER BY name,version

sections.title: Dataset completeness
sections.sql: SELECT m.name||' '||m.version AS model,q.external_id,q.kind,q.expected_count,q.loaded_count,q.outcome_count,q.missing_features FROM dataset_quality q JOIN models m ON m.id=q.model_id ORDER BY model,q.external_id

sections.title: Overdue follow-ups
sections.sql: SELECT m.name||' '||m.version AS model,a.title,a.owner,a.due FROM actions a JOIN models m ON m.id=a.model_id WHERE a.status='open' AND a.due<current_date ORDER BY a.due

sections.title: Evidence checks
sections.sql: SELECT m.name||' '||m.version AS model,f.rule,f.due,f.source_rule FROM compliance_findings f JOIN models m ON m.id=f.model_id ORDER BY model,f.rule
